svg.title: World-tube centerline projection
svg.desc: What this figure shows: A persistent moving subsystem defines a time-indexed spatial trajectory, illustrating the handoff from observer localization to causal analysis. The plotted object is generated from W=(S_0,...,S_T-1). How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Synthetic spatiotemporal illustration. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
